Callout.Name: Armed Robbery - Off Licence
Callout.Message: Armed robbery in progress at an off licence.
Callout.Advisory: One suspect with a handgun, staff inside, no shots fired yet.

Script.Line: I have not touched the till. Ask them, I have not touched it.
The gun is not real. Look at it, it is not real.
I came in for cigarettes. That is the whole of it.

Lines.Briefing: Armed robbery in progress. They are still inside and the staff are still in there with them.
Lines.Approach: One suspect, handgun, in the off licence now. Get there before they leave.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
